original_test_intent: Verify the approved SUT remains responsive and healthy during an exactly 20-minute no-test-workload idle interval.
original_method: Agent starts a tracked 20-minute timer, samples host and BMC stability/health periodically, preserves background activity and compares approved thresholds.
manual_activity: User supplies idle/health thresholds and known-event policy, then reviews the complete time-series comparison; no physical step is required.
required_inputs: Approved host identity and OS/kernel/firmware baseline
Expected scheduled/background activity and known-event policy
Secure read-only OS/BMC access and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Do not stop background jobs or change power/performance policy
Use read-only collectors with bounded overhead
Preserve boot ID, time and full raw samples
Stop on hang, reboot, panic/BSOD, storage/filesystem/RAID, thermal/power/BMC fault or monitoring loss
Do not reboot or repair automatically
agent_execution_scope: Track exact monotonic duration, connectivity and boot identity
Produce threshold/event comparison and final health state
Do not modify workload/services/policy, suppress activity or issue DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Provide thresholds and allowed background activity
Resolve threshold breaches or contradictory health data
Review time series and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: uptime is a useful sample but a single pair cannot prove stability and approximately 30 minutes violates the literal 20-minute scope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run a low-overhead tracked collector at approved cadence for exactly 20 minutes, preserving load/process/memory/I/O/temperature/power/storage and OS/BMC errors.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS boot, no-test-workload idle, exact 20 minutes and source 5/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use monotonic timing and periodic multidomain health samples with boot-ID continuity and explicit threshold comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds evidence resolution while keeping the source's passive idle behavior and exact duration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Fully automates observation only; it does not start stress or suppress normal background work.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Undefined idle thresholds or scheduled maintenance can make the result inconclusive rather than a hardware failure.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must define acceptable background services, sample cadence and health thresholds; the agent cannot equate nonzero load with failure or change the 20-minute duration.
expected_evidence: Exact monotonic 20-minute timer and sampling timestamps
Periodic load, CPU, memory, process and I/O data
Thermal, power, storage/filesystem/RAID and BMC health
Connectivity, hang/reboot/watchdog and complete OS/BMC logs
Threshold/known-event comparison, collector cleanup and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define an exact 20-minute idle stability check; DeepSeek's 30-minute wording is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Thresholds and monitoring access are supplyable inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Corrects the duration and replaces two low-value uptime points with a complete passive stability/health time series.
independent_technical_reasoning: An uptime value proves only that a command returned at two moments; it can miss short hangs, OOM events, thermal excursions, storage errors or a reboot between samples. Monotonic timing, boot-ID continuity and periodic multidomain health/log evidence are required to establish uninterrupted idle stability without introducing a workload.
